title: Bedrockite
description: This mod adds a survival friendly but a hard way to destroy bedrock. It adds a material called bedrockite which can be used to upgrade a netherite pickaxe to a bedrockite pickaxe (which can mine bedrock)
body:
# Bedrockite

Ever wanted to finally break through and harness the power of bedrock? **Bedrockite** introduces a late-game tier of material that allows you to do exactly that. 

## Features

* **New Material (Bedrockite):** A rare and powerful resource used to craft the ultimate tool—the **Bedrockite Pickaxe**.
* **Mine Bedrock:** Equipped with the Bedrockite Pickaxe, you can finally mine vanilla Bedrock blocks in survival mode.
* **Cracked Bedrock:** To keep things balanced, breaking bedrock in survival yields **Cracked Bedrock**, which can then be broken with any standard tool.
* **Deep World Generation:** Explore the lowest depths of your world! New Bedrockite ores now generate directly within the vanilla bedrock layers of both the **Overworld** and the **Nether**.

---

## Addons

* Bedrockite Tools [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrockite-tools) (still being worked on)
* Bedrockite Armor [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrockite-armor) (still being worked on)
